messages:
tanya.sales: Heads-up — Horizon Trust wants a tight evidence bundle for the Dedicated POC. Ask list: SOC2 system description, ISO network diagram, signed pen-test acceptance, proof of last external vuln scan (sanitized), a chain-of-custody statement for delivered artifacts, and confirmation who signs (they asked for VP Security). They want everything in their dataroom by Thu EOD.

leo.se: Quick clarifier: Dedicated single-tenant, right? If so, chain-of-custody can mention staging presigned uploads + checksum verification. Also confirm whether they want realtime SIEM ingestion or batch archives.

violet.security: Dedicated confirmed. We can provide the SOC2 excerpt and ISO diagram. Pen-test attestation: Legal signs, Security provides an attestation stamp. If they insist on VP Security signature we can escalate but add ~48h. For chain-of-custody, we usually include: artifact filename, SHA256 checksum, presigned upload timestamp, and ops ticket id.

tanya.sales: They explicitly asked VP Security initially. I'll ask if Legal+Security stamp is acceptable to speed things. Also they asked for evidence notarization language 1 1 (something like a custody transfer note). Can we provide a short template?

sam.legal: We have a brief custody template; we can include a custody paragraph and signature block. If Horizon requests jurisdictional notarization or an exec sig we need to review. Legal+Security stamp is our standard. If they want notarization, note that adds procurement steps.

leo.se: Ops/transfer flow we recommend including (short): 1) we upload artifacts to presigned S3 path, 2) we publish SHA256 checksums, 3) we create a signed manifest (Legal+Security), 4) ops closes ticket with firewall/scan windows. Example checksum command to include in bundle: 

```bash
# generate sha256 for evidence bundle
sha256sum poc-bundle.zip > poc-bundle.zip.sha256
```

ops-bot: presign template (cached):

```bash
# upload evidence to presigned URL
curl -X PUT "https://storage.redwood.example/evidence/horizon/poc-bundle.zip?X-Amz-Signature=..." -H "Content-Type: application/zip" --data-binary @poc-bundle.zip
```

violet.security: Regarding the vuln scan raw report: we will by default supply a sanitized report (internal hostnames/IPs redacted). If they need raw vendor reports, require NDA addendum and Legal approval. Also, if they request prompt-level logs as part of chain-of-custody, that triggers DPA & product sign-off. Offer sanitized samples under NDA instead.

tanya.sales: Pricing question: they want notarization + VP signature + SIEM streaming included. Any ballpark?

leo.se: Ballpark: Dedicated baseline +$13k/mo, one-time provisioning $3k, SIEM streaming +30d retention +$1,100/mo, notarization/exec-sign handling (legal ops) one-time $1,000 (covers exec time & paperwork). If they want raw report access or prompt retention add more.

sam.legal: I'll prepare the custody paragraph and our standard pen-test attestation. If they accept our template, we can sign in ~48h. If they send redlines or request exec sign, expect 3-5 business days.

violet.security: I'll prepare the sanitized vuln report and the field map for any SIEM push (we support Splunk HEC or secure S3 archive). For HEC push we need their HEC token and TLS endpoint; for S3 batch we provide presigned archives and checksums.

leo.se: Example Splunk push snippet we can include in runbook:

```conf
# forward to customer's Splunk HEC over TLS
module(load=\"omhttp\")
action(type=\"omhttp\" server=\"https://splunk.horizon.example:8088\" bearerToken=\"<HEC_TOKEN>\" tls.cacert=\"/etc/ssl/certs/ca.pem\")
```

tanya.sales: Action items: 1) Sam prepare pen-test + custody paragraph (ETA 48h if using our template). 2) Violet prepare sanitized vuln report + SIEM field map (ETA 24h). 3) Ops to generate presigned upload path and post link here (ops-bot ETA 2h). 4) Leo to draft pricing line items for notarization/exec-sign option.

sam.legal: Doing that now. I'll also include signer options and timeline in the doc.

ops-bot: Firewall/scan ticket opened (#FW-22277). Presign link will be posted in #eng-infra in 2 hours. :gear:

leo.se: Blockers for the Horizon call: 1) acceptance of Legal+Security stamp vs VP exec sign, 2) presigned upload link + manifest/sha256, 3) final price including notarization. If any of those slip they may delay kickoff. :warning:
